name: Baron de Montesquieu
shortBio: French Enlightenment jurist and political philosopher who pioneered comparative political sociology and formulated the canonical doctrine of the separation of powers.
centralQuestion: How can the powers of government be distributed and balanced so that freedom is preserved and tyranny prevented?

keyWorks.title: The Spirit of the Laws (De l'esprit des lois)
keyWorks.description: Comparative treatise on constitutional systems and the tripartite separation of executive, legislative, and judicial powers.

keyWorks.title: Persian Letters (Lettres persanes)
keyWorks.description: Epistolary satire recounting the observations of two Persian travelers critiquing French absolutist society.
